programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: Professor Thom Archer is convinced that the drilling by a corporate energy company, Halo, is having a devastating impact on the Greenland Glacier, one that will have dire consequences for mankind. In the year 2020, global warming has had a profound impact on the world, transforming much of Europe into desert, with only the United Kingdom and the United States seemingly unaffected by a devastating rain drought. When Professor Archer visits the Arctic to prove his theory, he realizes the entirety of the planet is under serious threat, and races home to save the ones he loves, and anyone else who will listen. Science-fiction mini series.

programme.title: Gentle Ben: Terror On The Mountain
programme.desc: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Now You See It, Now You Don't
programme.desc: Mystery thriller starring Lea Thompson ('Back to the Future') as an undercover agent who investigates the theft of the Declaration of Independence from a Los Angeles bank. When her prime suspect is murdered, she finds herself taking on a master of deceit.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

programme.title: Just a Dream
programme.desc: Film crew arrives in a small town in Nevada desert. Ends up changing the life of a 12-year-old kid and a friend of his, a movie lover.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Blackout is a British TV drama series revolving around a corrupt council official who used to be an idealistic young man. Every new day brings him a new blackout because of alcohol, and sufferings to his family for the same reason. One day he gets his breath and realises he has become a murderer. He wants to tell his dark secret to his lawyer and goes to the court. There he becomes a witness of a shooting and covers an important witness with his own body. He becomes a local hero and people want to see him as the next mayor. He begins a dramatic quest for redemption.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: DNA evidence and camera footage places a corrupt CEO as the prime suspect in the murder of a company whistle-blower, but Jane Doe believes the real killer may be a twin sibling.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: A young woman on her way to a new life in the 1800s suddenly becomes a widow and must live with a recently-widowed young man and his daughter. Can any of them find love again?

programme.title: Prayers For Bobby
programme.desc: Emotional drama based on a true story. In 1970s America, a deeply devout mother finds her religious beliefs shaken when she learns that her son is gay. She urges her son to devote his time to the church in the hope that it will cure him of his 'sin', but the boy's increasing isolation leads to a tragic outcome. The woman is forced to question her faith and reassess her views.

programme.title: Sea Beast / Troglodyte
programme.desc: Mythic creatures emerge from the sea to feast on the residents of a fishing village.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: Daryl Dixon finds himself in France after his departure from The Commonwealth, raising the wrath of a broken but growing tyrannical movement in Paris and endangering a boy at the center of a benevolent religious movement.

programme.title: Family Gathering Aka You Lucky Dog
programme.desc: Sentimental romantic comedy starring Natasha Henstridge and Harry Hamlin. After her mother's death, a New York City fashion designer returns to her hometown and the family sheep farm.

programme.title: The Crooked E: The Unshredded Truth About Enron
programme.desc: Once he starts working for the Enron Corporation, young trader Brian Cruver is quickly caught up in the company's obsession with greed and partying. When Enron suddenly files for bankruptcy, Cruver is swept up in the disastrous collapse.

programme.title: The Secrets in the Walls
programme.desc: Horror starring Jeri Ryan. A mother and her two daughters move into an ancient house in a suburb of Detroit, when it is offered at a lower price than usual.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: Drama, with Dean Cain. Ranger Jack finds himself in prison after butting heads with Fog, who plans to drill for oil in his reserve, leaving Ben and Mark to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Mystery spy thriller about a housewife who leads a double life as an undercover government agent. When a major arms dealer stages an ingenious escape froman LA prison and sets out on a mission of vengeance, Jane Doe faces a race against time to protect the intended victim.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A man begins to have disturbing visions of dead people. All telling their story of how they died, and how their murderer is still out there. The detective investigating the murders looks to him for help in solving the case.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A medium and a detective join forces to uncover the identities of seven boys who have been murdered.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Cathy and Frank partner with a beautiful insurance investigator in the recovery of stolen art. Frank is smitten with her, even though it becomes more apparent she may be the mastermind behind the theft.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: Jasper, Texas
programme.desc: In 1998, three white men in the small town of Jasper, Texas, chained a black man to the back of their pickup truck and dragged him to his death. This film relates that story and how it affected all of the residents of the town, both black and white.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Ross Tanner successfully deals with his multiple identity mystery and the terrorist threats as well as a top-level conspiracy including the White House chief of staff, which La Mangouste fails to protect against him. Wally Sheridan is elected instead of president Galbraith, who thanks him and general Carrington. Yet 'XIII' senses something isn't right.

programme.title: Teens (aka She's Too Young)
programme.desc: The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.title: Family Gathering Aka You Lucky Dog
programme.desc: Sentimental romantic comedy starring Natasha Henstridge and Harry Hamlin. After her mother's death, a New York City fashion designer returns to her hometown and the family sheep farm.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: When Eliza (Sydney Penny) loses her father-in-law she is left to raise two children, continue work on an unharvested orange crop, and maintain a heavy mortgage. She begins to lose faith until her Aunt Batty (Shirley Jones) persuades her to persevere. Suddenly a mysterious stranger called Gabe (Jason Gedrick) turns up and helps Eliza with the harvest just in time to stop the bank from taking over. The more Eliza learns about Gabe, the more she realizes she loves him.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Wrong Face
programme.desc: Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: Historical drama with Patrick Stewart. In 1183, after the death of his eldest son, King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: Historical drama with Patrick Stewart. In 1183, after the death of his eldest son, King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same 'street' family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: " Devil Boy ", once foundling in the port of Shanghai , has become a avaontuurlijke young thief . He steals every street as he considers his family to be able to provide food . Now he has with his faithful companion Bird devised a cunning plan to steal the jewels of the royal palace . For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: Twelve years after the emperor's death, the Fremen armies have successfully subdued all known planets, killing off millions in numerous battles. The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Cathy and Frank partner with a beautiful insurance investigator in the recovery of stolen art. Frank is smitten with her, even though it becomes more apparent she may be the mastermind behind the theft.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom
programme.desc: The Forbidden Kingdom (2008) is a kung fu wuxia film directed by Rob Minkoff and starring Jackie Chan and Jet Li. Teenager Jason, who lives in South Boston, is crazy about kung fu. One day he makes an amazing discovery: in one of Chinatown shops he finds the legendary staff which belongs to the great warrior Monkey King. The magic staff sends Jason on an adventure to ancient China, where he joins an army of highly skilled warriors gathered to free their imprisoned king.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. programme.title: Prayers For Bobby
programme.desc: Emotional drama based on a true story. In 1970s America, a deeply devout mother finds her religious beliefs shaken when she learns that her son is gay. She urges her son to devote his time to the church in the hope that it will cure him of his 'sin', but the boy's increasing isolation leads to a tragic outcome. The woman is forced to question her faith and reassess her views.

programme.title: The Secrets in the Walls
programme.desc: Horror starring Jeri Ryan. A mother and her two daughters move into an ancient house in a suburb of Detroit, when it is offered at a lower price than usual.

programme.title: A Sudden Fury
programme.desc: Thriller with Neil Patrick Harris. A teenage boy finds his mother and father murdered in their home, but as the story goes on he reveals he knows more than he is letting on.

programme.title: Replacing Dad
programme.desc: Linda and George live in a small town. He is the school principal. They are about to celebrate their 16th anniversary. She catches him with her daughter's young teacher, and has to deal with the kids, the town and her love to him.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Yes, I Remember It Well
programme.desc: Mystery drama about a housewife who leads a double life as a government agent. Jane Doe has to find a missing British agent who has knowledge of the names and addresses of every UK operative in the Middle East. Was the man kidnapped, or did he arrange his own disappearance?

programme.title: Gentle Ben: Terror On The Mountain
programme.desc: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben.

programme.title: Johnson County War
programme.desc: Part 1 of 2. The year is 1891 and Wyoming is in its first year of statehood. The three Hammett brothers, Cain, Harry and Dale, find themselves in the middle of a rapidly escalating range war that pits cattle barons against homesteaders.

programme.title: Johnson County War
programme.desc: Conclusion. Rich and powerful competitors try to destroy three Wyoming brothers as they struggle to survive in the cattle business.

programme.title: The Society Murders
programme.desc: A building inspector arrives at Wentworth to inspect the rebuilding, but he's a fake. Once inside the jail, he knocks Colleen out, ties her up, and plants bombs around the prison. Meg rescues Colleen, but the women have been locked in the laundry with a bomb inside ticking away... Sharon is charged with murder as Alpha Centauri's true nature is exposed in the press, shattering her illusions. Helen decides to implicate herself to help her sister. Lizzie gets wind of Petra and Scott's relationship but vows to keep quiet. Petra tells Lizzie her father abused her, and was going to do the same to her sister, Emma, which is why she killed him. Later, when Emma visits Petra, we learn it was actually Emma who killed him. Lucy attacks Major the dog to stop him finding her drugs, and a furious Joan turfs her out. Ann forgives Wally. Lizzie gets a telegram from Foxy.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A man begins to have disturbing visions of dead people. All telling their story of how they died, and how their murderer is still out there. The detective investigating the murders looks to him for help in solving the case.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A medium and a detective join forces to uncover the identities of seven boys who have been murdered.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Icon
programme.desc: On the eve of the elections in Russia, there's an outbreak of a mysterious disease. The British are curious to find out what's going on, so they need to send someone. An official knows someone, Jason Monk, an American Agent who worked deep cover in Russia during the Cold War. He approaches Monk, who initially refuses till he tells Monk that he can help him settle some old scores and to see his daughter whom he left when he was pulled out. So Monk goes and makes contact with an old friend and a Russian policewoman. They learn that someone is trying to manipulate the election.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: EuroLeague. 1/2 final. Olympiacos - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. 1/2 final. Olympiacos - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Savute is a land where natural law is taken to its limit and sometimes... beyond. Across six episodes we see the full impact that the cycle of Savute's seasons has on every carnivore clan. The rains leave a time of birth and plenty in their wake, but all too soon the soil is parched and the grass gone. Rival tribes of predators are squeezed into a cauldron of competition. This season in Savute, who will survive?

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: The Croc That Ate Jaws
programme.desc: What happens when two of the world's most deadly predators go head to head? Drawing on spectacular UGC from around the world, shark and croc experts Dr Mike Heithaus and Dr James Nifong unpack and analyse the evidence.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The second part focuses on the challenges of the future: How do the national parks deal with invasive species from outside and what success stories can be reported? For instance, in the Hohe Tauern National Park the previously extinct ibexes and bearded vultures have been reintroduced. In the Gesäuse National Park Avalanches created one of the most species-rich habitats, which rare butterflies like the Red Apollo colonize.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Wild Uganda

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson's bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: India's Wild Leopards
programme.desc: India may be the land of the Tiger, but it is also home to masters of stealth that prowl the deepest of jungles and the highest of mountains. Journey to Ladakh in the Himalaya in search of Snow Leopards - the ghost of the mountains. Then venture into the realm of the smallest of big cats - the Clouded Leopard in the jungles of north east India. Wildlife Cameraman and National Geographic Fellow, Sandesh Kadur is on a mission to uncover their secretive lives.

programme.title: Jade Eyed Leopard
programme.desc: We follow Toto, a sea-green-eyed leopard during the first year of her life, as she learns the vital skills to survive.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Built to Survive

programme.title: Perfect Predator
programme.desc: From their massive size, strength and stamina to their finely tuned hunting skills and unrelenting will to survive—sharks have evolved to be the perfect predator. But how do they do it? In this action-packed hour, unlock key evolutionary components that have kept these apex predators on top for millions of years.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: Whether searching for prey in the tropical canopy or stalking a meal over a spongy moss carpet, forest predators rely on stealth-like skills to survive. Natural instincts kick in right from birth, and in one never-before-seen case, even before birth. For the first time captured on camera, watch glass frog embryos hatch early to escape a little-known but lethal wasp, while their father fiercely defends the babies with his martial arts moves.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: There are still places on Earth where fields of grass stretch as far as the eye can see. In order to survive in these open spaces, predators must hide in plain sight. On the vast plains of the African savanna, banded mongooses rely on strength in numbers in order to succeed in a land of giants. Cheetahs and secretary birds must conquer extreme heat and elusive prey, risking their lives to feed their offspring. Mongolian wolves hunt for scarce food on the steppe.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: Secret Life of Predators is a National Geography documentary series narrated by Boone Smith, exploring animals that are on the top of the food chains in the environments they inhabit, such as eagles, tigers and bears. Meet some of the deadliest creatures, from rainforests and African savannas to the depths of the ocean. Find out the strategies these animals use to fight for their survival, and why are these hunter species the most successful when it comes to it.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

programme.title: Deep Sea Dwellers
programme.desc: Movie special-effect gurus are forever trying to invent more compelling creatures from other planets, hoping to terrorize our imaginations. To do this, they often draw from the natural world, and few creatures fit the bill more than the cephalopods: shapeshifters, with three hearts, blue blood and holes in their brains. But while they might look like creatures from another galaxy, these aliens have called Earth home for hundreds of millions of years. In our quest to find intelligent life, we search among the stars, but perhaps we should be looking closer to home. The octopus, squid and cuttlefish are some of the most intelligent creatures in the animal kingdom. They have colonized all of the world's oceans and are widespread in even the darkest corners of the abyss. So, forget Hollywood; there are aliens in the deep.

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.desc: It is pure luck to have a genie to fulfill all wishes, to have two of them is something incredible. Leah is a little girl with a genie bottle necklace, which includes Shimmer and Shine, genie twins. Shimmer is a genie with blue eyes and pink hair, encouraging and passionate, she has a pet, a gibbon monkey Tala. Shine is her twin genie with purple eyes and blue hair, big animal lover. Her pet is a little Bengal tiger Nahal. Zac is Leah's neighbor with red hair and blue eyes, and her best human friend. Leah is making three wishes every day, genies are doing their best but the results are far from perfect, as genies are very young and unskilled. This is the source of awkward and comic situations, but in the end girls manage to get over all difficulties.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.desc: Rusty Rivets is a fantastic and picturesque animated series about Rusty who lives in Sparkton Hills along with his friend Ruby Ramirez, a robotic tyrannosaurid named Botasaur, and a group of smaller robots known as the Bits. Rusty is a smart inventor and a little genius who with the help of his amazing discoveries helps his friends out of difficulties. Rusty constructs robots of different sizes, forms and purposes, he is in love with science, technology and engineering. Together with his friend Ruby they can repair any old machinery and out-of-date equipment. Their splendid intellect arouses envy and toxic rivals do not play the game clean.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: Max & the Midknights fly to the village of Tresk to search for the missing Gnomes and discover a series of mysterious holes in the nearby forest. Before they can investigate, the kids are chased by two angry Ogres and run into Rovak, one of the kidnapped Gnomes from Tresk. Desperate to evade the Ogres, Rovak and the Midknights take shelter in a cottage owned by their friends, Bean and Barley. Rovak tells the Midknights how and why the Gnomes were kidnapped, but the story is interrupted when the two Ogres show up. As the Midknights and Rovak hide from the Ogres, Millie concocts a potion. But the kids are caught and the potion has an unexpected result: it turns the Midknights into gnomes. Meanwhile, Mumblin begins community service at Outpost 71, a mysterious factory run by penguins. Mumblin is relieved to learn that his friend Lenny is also serving community service, but when Mumblin learns that his sentence lasts ten thousand years, he decides to escape. Unfortunately, there's no way out. Or is there?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

But the kids are caught and the potion has an unexpected result: it turns the Midknights into gnomes. Meanwhile, Mumblin begins community service at Outpost 71, a mysterious factory run by penguins. Mumblin is relieved to learn that his friend Lenny is also serving community service, but when Mumblin learns that his sentence lasts ten thousand years, he decides to escape. Unfortunately, there's no way out. Or is there?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The opening of a time capsule buried at the zoo a century ago, forces the penguins, Julien, Maurice, Mort, Marlene and Fred into a search for the legendary cursed treasure of the Golden Squirrel, which they must find and destroy before the rats claim it for themselves, but matters are complicated when the treasure includes a curse that will drive those who seek it to fight each other until one who is "pure of heart" claims the treasure.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: No Hat for Pat: Patrick is sick of all of his friends not being able to play with him because they have to put on their Krusty Krab hats and go to work. So when Mr. Krabs offers him a job as a sign-holder, Patrick is thrilled because it means he gets to wear a hat and work with all his friends! But Pat soon learns that wearing a hat isn't as simple as it looks. Toy Store of Doom: A new toy store has opened up in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob and Patrick couldn't be happier! In fact, they are having so much fun at the toy store that they accidentally get locked in when it closes. They soon find out that things are a lot different at the toy store when no one's around...

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: One year after Mandroid's defeat and the Emberstone's shattering, the Malto's go on a search for the Embershards. When a Decepticon creates a new foe from a broken shard, the Malto's realize life in Witwicky is about to be chaotic.

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: When Ghoulia's anxiety manifests as a monster, she hurries to get rid of it before an appointment with the school counselor. // Worried for Frankie's safety, the Drs. Stein reprogram Frankie's latest robot invention to protect them at all costs!

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Lilio OSC - Osero AJ
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. programme.title: Ridiculousness: Veri American Idiots
programme.desc: Rob, Chanel e Steelo decidono che si devono sempre pagare le spese di consegna in DIY DELIVERY e si rendono conto che la capacità di dormire ovunque è una SLEEP SKILLS.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Veri American Idiots
programme.desc: Rob, Steelo e Camille Kostek entrano nello spirito delle feste in DECORATION FRUSTRATION e sono toccati dai fantasmi in GHOST FALLS.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Veri American Idiots

programme.desc: Simona Izzo e Ricky Tognazzi raccontano la storia d'amore tra Francesca Morvillo e Giovanni Falcone: un rapporto intenso che li vedrà uniti fino agli ultimi istanti delle loro vite.

programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: Un Semplice Incidente
programme.desc: In Iran un uomo incontra per caso una persona che ritiene essere stata il suo torturatore. L'uomo nega strenuamente di essere coinvolto nella faccenda, cosa che insospettisce ancora di più chi lo ha riconosciuto.

programme.title: L'ora più buia

Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Quella sporca ultima meta
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds nel classico del genere carcerario di Robert Aldrich. In prigione per guida in stato di ebbrezza, un ex campione di rugby viene costretto ad allenare una squadra di detenuti.

programme.title: Le buone stelle - Broker
programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.title: Mystic River
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.title: Italia 1982 - Una storia azzurra
programme.desc: Il documentario che ripercorre il trionfo della nazionale italiana di calcio al Mundial spagnolo: una vittoria indelebile che ha ispirato una generazione e riunito un'intera nazione.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Peter Weir racconta un'impresa disperata in un film con Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris e Colin Farrell. Evasi da un lager siberiano, un gruppo di uomini intraprende una fuga in condizioni estreme.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: Il colore della libertà
programme.desc: Biopic prodotto da Spike Lee. 1961: Bob Zellner, studente universitario dell'Alabama e nipote di un membro del Ku Klux Klan, decide di schierarsi in difesa dei diritti degli afroamericani.

programme.title: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - Ep. 476 - Intervista A Edoardo Leo
programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.title: Bolero
programme.desc: La genesi ossessiva della celebre partitura di Maurice Ravel nel biopic di Anne Fontaine. La vita, la carriera e il tormento creativo dell'artista, fino al suo capolavoro musicale.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Rush

programme.title: Dogman (2018)
programme.desc: Marcello Fonte, premiato a Cannes, ed Edoardo Pesce nel film di Matteo Garrone ispirato a un fatto di cronaca. Periferia di Roma: un mite toelettatore reagisce ai soprusi del suo aguzzino.

programme.title: Anora
programme.desc: 5 Oscar e Palma d'oro a Cannes alla travolgente commedia di Sean Baker con Mikey Madison e Mark Eydelshteyn. Una spogliarellista di New York sposa il figlio miliardario di un oligarca russo, ma i suoceri inviano i loro sgherri negli Stati Uniti per annullare il matrimonio.

programme.title: Giulio Regeni: Tutto il male del mondo
programme.desc: Gli eventi relativi alla morte di Giulio Regeni, rapito, torturato e ucciso in Egitto, con la ricostruzione della sua famiglia e dell'avvocato Alessandra Ballerini, che illustrano le fasi del rapimento, della tortura e dell'omicidio.

programme.title: Emilia Perez
programme.desc: 2 Oscar, Miglior attrice e Premio della giuria a Cannes per l'originale pellicola di Jacques Audiard con Zoe Saldana, Karla Sofia Gascon, Selena Gomez.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Kate Winslet, vincitrice del Golden Globe, in un dramma coniugale diretto da Sam Mendes, che racconta la crisi di una coppia borghese nell'America degli anni 50.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: Le musiche di Eddie Vedder e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Un diciottenne lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un intimo viaggio a contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: Saint Judy
programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.title: Anora
programme.desc: 5 Oscar e Palma d'oro a Cannes alla travolgente commedia di Sean Baker con Mikey Madison e Mark Eydelshteyn. Una spogliarellista di New York sposa il figlio miliardario di un oligarca russo, ma i suoceri inviano i loro sgherri negli Stati Uniti per annullare il matrimonio.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Le otto montagne
programme.desc: Miglior film ai David di Donatello e Premio della giuria a Cannes per la storia di amicizia tra Pietro (Luca Marinelli) e Bruno (Alessandro Borghi) e il loro legame con la montagna.

programme.title: Sentimental Value
programme.desc: Nora e Agnes, due sorelle molto unite, si ritrovano a dover affrontare il ritorno del padre, regista carismatico ma assente nelle loro vite. L'uomo desidera realizzare il suo ultimo film e includere una delle figlie nel progetto.

programme.title: La stanza del figlio
programme.desc: Palma d'Oro a Cannes per la toccante pellicola di Nanni Moretti, anche protagonista con Laura Morante. Legami familiari attraversati da luci e ombre, fino all’irruzione del dolore.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.title: Cattive acque
programme.desc: Mark Ruffalo e Anne Hathaway in un dramma legale di impegno civile, tratto da una storia vera e diretto da Todd Haynes. Rischiando in prima persona, un coraggioso avvocato sfida una potente multinazionale accusandola di aver inquinato per anni l’acqua di una zona degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: The Young Messiah
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Anne Rice, una pellicola che ripercorre l'infanzia di Gesu'. A 7 anni il futuro Messia lascia l'Egitto per tornare a Nazareth dove scopre le sue vere origini.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: No Other Choice - Non c'è altra scelta
programme.desc: Le contraddizioni della società coreana nel film di Park Chan-wook presentato a Venezia. Licenziato dopo 25 anni, un uomo vede andare in frantumi la sua vita "perfetta".

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Sentimental Value
programme.desc: Nora e Agnes, due sorelle molto unite, si ritrovano a dover affrontare il ritorno del padre, regista carismatico ma assente nelle loro vite. L'uomo desidera realizzare il suo ultimo film e includere una delle figlie nel progetto.

programme.title: Codice d'onore
programme.desc: Tom Cruise sfida Jack Nicholson in un dramma giudiziario con Demi Moore e Kevin Bacon. Tre avvocati militari difendono due marines accusati dell'omicidio di un commilitone.

programme.desc: La prova che hanno recuperato non è sufficiente. Rosa e Cociss devono puntare ancora più in alto e proseguire le indagini o saranno spacciati.

programme.desc: Un documentario biografico basato sui ricordi di due artisti famosi. Il regista Roman Polanski e il fotografo Ryszard Horowitz tornano insieme in Polonia dopo 60 anni, e tra le strade di Cracovia ripercorrono l'infanzia e la giovinezza segnate dalla Shoah.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Blockbuster di Halloween per tutta la famiglia. Il Conte Dracula organizza una festa per il compleanno della figlia Mavis, ma tra gli ospiti c'e' un intruso...

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

programme.title: Alla fine ci sei tu
programme.desc: Asa Butterfield e Maisie Williams in una storia di crescita. Un ragazzo ipocondriaco affronta le sue peggiori paure quando accetta di esaudire gli ultimi desideri di una coetanea malata.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova analizzano la serie Downton Abbey.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: Il marchio DreamWorks su un film d'animazione tratto dai libri a fumetti per bambini di Dav Pilkey. Feriti in un incidente, un cane poliziotto e il suo collega umano sono sottoposti a un intervento che li fonde insieme. Nasce Dog Man, creatura ibrida al servizio della città contro un malvagio gatto arancione.

programme.title: I Goonies
programme.desc: Richard Donner firma una memorabile avventura ideata e prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Un gruppo di ragazzi trova una mappa che conduce al leggendario tesoro di un pirata.

programme.title: C'è tempo
programme.desc: Stefano Fresi in una commedia 'on the road' di Walter Veltroni. Alla morte del padre, un quarantenne 'osservatore di arcobaleni' scopre di avere un fratellastro minorenne.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro - Parte II
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della trilogia di Robert Zemeckis con Michael J. Fox e Christopher Lloyd. Marty e Doc volano nel 2015, innescando una serie di eventi che cambieranno anche il passato.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe al magico fantasy con Cynthia Erivo e Ariana Grande. Nel regno di Oz, l’aspirante strega Galinda conosce la solitaria Elphaba. Canzoni in lingua originale.

programme.title: Genitori vs Influencer
programme.desc: Fabio Volo, Ginevra Francesconi e Giulia De Lellis nella commedia Sky Original di Michela Andreozzi. Un prof si scontra con la figlia teenager per colpa dei social... ma diventa influencer.

programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.desc: Brendan Fraser nel remake di un classico degli anni 50. Tre esploratori si inoltrano sotto la superficie terrestre alla scoperta di un regno sconosciuto, abitato da minacciose creature.

programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.desc: Dal produttore di "Shrek", un film d’animazione sull'avvenente eroe delle fiabe. Il principe Filippo vuole spezzare l'incantesimo che lo ha 'condannato' a sedurre tutte le donne.

programme.title: La Piccola Amelie
programme.desc: Amélie è una bambina belga nata in Giappone. Grazie al suo amico, Nishio San, il mondo è pieno di avventure e scoperte. Il giorno del suo terzo compleanno, un evento cambia il corso della sua vita.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un altro emozionante capolavoro d'animazione. Hiccup, figlio di un capo vichingo, affronta il drago che minaccia la sua tribu' ma finisce per stringerci amicizia.

programme.title: Belle e Sebastien - Next Generation
programme.desc: Un omaggio ai personaggi creati da Cecile Aubry ambientato ai giorni nostri. Il giovane Sebastien, in vacanza in montagna dalla nonna, stringe amicizia con un bellissimo cane Patou.

programme.title: Pedro galletto coraggioso: Missione Africa
programme.desc: Avventuroso sequel animato con il simpatico pennuto. Pedro e Di sono i genitori di due piccole uova dorate, che vengono rapite e portate in Africa dalla cattivissima Duchessa.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: Avventurosa fiaba fantasy con Michelle Pfeiffer, Charlie Cox e Robert De Niro. Un ragazzo entra in un regno magico per catturare la stella cadente che ha promesso alla sua amata.

programme.title: Lego Batman - Il film
programme.desc: Animazione digitale e mattoncini Lego si combinano di nuovo per un’avventura targata DC. Batman si allea con la Justice League per sconfiggere i supercattivi capitanati da Joker.

programme.title: C'era una volta il Principe Azzurro
programme.desc: Dal produttore di "Shrek", un film d’animazione sull'avvenente eroe delle fiabe. Il principe Filippo vuole spezzare l'incantesimo che lo ha 'condannato' a sedurre tutte le donne.

programme.title: xXx - Il ritorno di Xander Cage

programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della strepitosa saga di fantascienza con Keanu Reeves e Laurence Fishburne. Neo lotta senza tregua per evitare la distruzione di Zion e salvare Trinity da un oscuro destino.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Il mito di Batman secondo Joel Schumacher con Val Kilmer, Jim Carrey, Tommy Lee Jones e Nicole Kidman. L'uomo pipistrello deve sventare i piani di due nemici: L'Enigmista e Due Facce.

programme.title: Songbird
programme.desc: Prodotto da Michael Bay, un thriller che immagina un drammatico futuro. 2024: le continue mutazioni del Covid-19 hanno chiuso il mondo in un eterno lockdown. In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

programme.desc: Fenomeni paranormali nell'horror di Giorgio Bruno. Durante la realizzazione di un documentario, un tecnico del suono registra voci spaventose provenienti dall'Aldilà. Insieme a una vecchia amica tenterà di capirne il significato, mentre macabri eventi lo perseguitano.

programme.title: The Prestige
programme.desc: Meraviglia e suspense con Hugh Jackman e Christian Bale, per la regia di Christopher Nolan. La Londra di fine 800 fa da sfondo all'accesa e ossessiva rivalita' tra due illusionisti.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone dalla parte della legge in un appassionante thriller con Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel e Ray Liotta. Lo sceriffo di una piccola cittadina del New Jersey, abitata soprattutto da poliziotti e per questo soprannominata 'Cop Land', non ha mai fatto carriera. Si limita a svolgere mansioni di poco conto all'ombra dei più agguerriti, e quotati, colleghi in divisa. Ma l'occasione per dimostrare il suo valore arriva, quando è costretto a indagare su una tragedia provocata proprio da uno sbirro e insabbiata dal resto dei poliziotti.

programme.desc: Pallottole e droga nella Marsiglia degli anni 70 in un action con il premio Oscar Jean Dujardin. Un temerario giudice conduce un'ostinata battaglia contro un padrino della malavita.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

programme.desc: Juli Grabenhenrich e Luca Marinelli in un dramma familiare scritto e diretto da Alissa Jung. Una quindicenne tedesca giunge a Rimini per incontrare finalmente il padre biologico italiano, confrontandosi con l'uomo vulnerabile e tormentato che non l'ha mai voluta conoscere.

programme.title: Soldato Jane
programme.desc: Demi Moore e Viggo Mortensen in un film di Ridley Scott. Una donna si sottopone a un addestramento massacrante agli ordini di un sadico istruttore per entrare nei Navy Seals.

programme.title: Father Mother Sister Brother
programme.desc: I membri di tre famiglie distanti si riuniscono: un fratello e una sorella fanno visita all'eccentrico padre, le due figlie di una scrittrice confrontano la madre davanti a una tazza di tè, due gemelli devono gestire l'appartamento dei genitori.

programme.title: In viaggio con Adele
programme.desc: Alessandro Haber, Sara Serraiocco e Isabella Ferrari in un toccante road movie. Un anziano attore scopre di avere una figlia e parte con lei per un viaggio che cambiera' le loro vite.

programme.title: L'ultima tentazione di Cristo
programme.desc: La pellicola cult di Martin Scorsese con Willem Dafoe e Harvey Keitel. Sulla croce, Gesù immagina come sarebbe stata la sua vita se avesse rinunciato alla missione divina.

programme.title: Still Life
programme.desc: Struggente riflessione sulla vita premiata a Venezia. Il lavoro di John May e' organizzare il funerale delle persone morte in solitudine. Il suo ultimo incarico gli farà scoprire se stesso.

programme.title: Scomode verità
programme.desc: Mike Leigh dirige un potente dramma con Marianne Jean-Baptiste e Michele Austin. Pansy, una donna astiosa e irascibile, sempre in conflitto con il mondo, trova finalmente la forza di confessare il segreto che ferisce il suo animo durante una riunione di famiglia.

programme.title: Lovely Boy
programme.desc: Andrea Carpenzano nel film Sky Original di Francesco Lettieri. L'ascesa e il declino di Nic, in arte Lovely Boy, astro nascente della scena musicale romana finito nel baratro della droga.

programme.title: La notte più lunga dell'anno

programme.title: Come ti spaccio la famiglia
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya Kanie, a handsome, scholastically successful and athletic high school student, freaks out when his classmate, Isuzu Sento, points a musket at him and demands he take her on a date to an amusement park.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya must accept the reality of his situation after learning that residents of the magic nation of Maple Land operate the park and receiving the ability to hear people's minds by its owner, Queen Latifah.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Circumstances land Seiya the position of acting owner for the park; he proposes reforms to meet the goal of attracting 250,000 visitors within three months, but the crew has a lot of complaints.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Though arrogant, Seiya solves problem after problem at the park; Isuzu wants to be happy about it, but something bothers her.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: With the 30-yen offer, the number of visitors slowly improves, but money remains an issue; attempting to find quick cash, Seiya visits Moffle, and they set off to search for a supposed treasure hidden in a cave.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Isuzu has mixed feelings about Seiya's expert handling of the issues at the park, even having nightmares about her own work; she resolves to fix the labor shortage by interviewing potential hires.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Summer arrives and Splash Ocean, the water park area, buzzes with guests; Isuzu, Muse and the other four fairies wear pirate costumes; Joe the shark notices something wrong in the machine room.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya collapses from fatigue and a cold after busily managing the park for the past few days; Seiya worries about his attendance at school, so Moffle and others pretend to be Seiya by wearing Mogoot Clan's magical clone suit and going to school.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Muse and others practice for a new show, but have trouble coordinating; Latifah decides to host a sukiyaki party to deepen their friendship.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: The staff tries to put together a promotional video to attract more visitors to the park.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya becomes more determined than ever after finding out Latifah's secret; he comes up with an idea that will help them achieve the target visitor count before the predetermined deadline and orders Tricen, the head of sales, to gather information.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.sub-title: No One Can Predict the Future!
programme.desc: The park sets a new attendance record after being selected as the venue for a soccer match; as visitors file through the entrance gates, Latifah prays for them to achieve the target visitor count; Seiya makes an announcement about the land they sold.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Attendance increases after the park renovates some of the attractions and starts night parades, but Seiya grimly wonders if they can reach the target visitor count before the deadline.
